title: Facebook Marketplace Automation Bot Update v1.0.8
description:
• 🛡️ Fixed Arkose Labs MatchKey Blank Screen: Removed prototype-tampering scripts that corrupted Arkose Labs integrity checks and caused white-screen freezing.
• 🌐 Authentic Desktop Login Pipeline: Replaced mobile endpoint with official desktop login flow (facebook.com/login.php) preventing device-mismatch fraud flags.
• 🔑 Intelligent 2FA Auto-Detection & Polling: Dynamic polling loop automatically detects 2FA prompts, generates 6-digit TOTP codes from 2FA secrets, and supports 300s seamless manual code entry without timeouts.
• 💾 Session Protection: Browser sessions automatically preserve validated state so subsequent launches and listings never trigger redundant security checkpoints.
